name: SONGS1
summary: SONGS1 demonstrated unattended antineutrino monitoring of a commercial reactor at San Onofre. It tested whether a small detector outside containment could track reactor power and fuel evolution without disturbing plant operation.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-loaded liquid scintillator detects prompt positron and delayed neutron-capture light from inverse beta decay. Passive shielding and a cosmic veto suppress backgrounds; automated analysis follows the antineutrino rate over long periods.
